**Here are the states we’re targeting — and why:**
→ **Arizona:** Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
→ **Michigan:** While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
→ **New Hampshire:** It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest.
→ **Pennsylvania:** Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. If we can protect the House majority *and* flip the Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta and have the ability to enact redistricting reform in Pennsylvania.
→ **Wisconsin:** Thanks to the state supreme court striking down Republican-drawn gerrymanders, Wisconsinites have their first opportunity in over a decade to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. With ongoing investment, we can build power and ensure fair maps are drawn moving forward.
While each of these states has a unique profile and different goals, they all need our help.

clean_body: Here’s what these 5 states all have in common | Peter, I want to take a moment to explain why our new partnership with The States Project focuses on winning legislative races in five specific states where our work can make a big difference. Below, I’ll go in more detail about each state we’re prioritizing together. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Here are the states we’re targeting — and why: → Arizona: Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. → Michigan: While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. → New Hampshire: It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. → Pennsylvania: Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. If we can protect the House majority and flip the Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta and have the ability to enact redistricting reform in Pennsylvania. → Wisconsin: Thanks to the state supreme court striking down Republican-drawn gerrymanders, Wisconsinites have their first opportunity in over a decade to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. With ongoing investment, we can build power and ensure fair maps are drawn moving forward. While each of these states has a unique profile and different goals, they all need our help. = Thank you, Claire Low = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. From certifying the Equal Rights Amendment so that we can restore reproductive rights nationwide to fighting gun violence and keeping our communities safe, I'm working tirelessly to win change for your family.
As my grandmother taught me when I was a young girl, politics isn't about parties or polling numbers._ It's about the people._ It's my job to serve your family and do everything that I can to make life better for _you_. And it's an honor that I'm grateful for every day. So thank you for trusting me with your support and giving me this incredible opportunity to serve.
I wish that I could end this email here. But unfortunately, elections are an unavoidable part of politics. And to continue to serve your family in the Senate and win progress on all the issues you care about — reproductive rights, affordable health care, protecting our seniors and so much more — **I need your help.**
Democrats are heading into a historically difficult election cycle. And here in New York, right-wing extremists had their best election in decades in 2022. Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Tonight is the first Presidential Debate of the 2024 election, which will mark the first time many voters start “tuning in” to the presidential race.

And you know _Planned Parenthood_ and their puppet President Joe Biden have one big goal in mind: **_abortion_.**

I know the media can’t get enough of all this . . .

But I want to know what YOU think.

**[So, can I count on you to please fill out your Presidential Survey right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gydajy-duchtdja-y/)?**

As a _Students for Life Action_ supporter, I greatly value your input.

But hearing directly from you on the critical issues we’re facing right now will help me know if I’m actually hitting the mark.

_Now more than ever, we need to let the Abortion Goliath know we’re coming for their bloody agenda._

Pro-Life Friend, thanks for all you do for Life.

**[Please fill out your Presidential Survey right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gydajy-duchtdja-j/)!**

For Life,

subject: a more personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mark Takano For Congress P
body:
| Peter—

This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country.

The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this.

There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done.

Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7.

Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States.

I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done. That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me:

“Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson
“Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump
“[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthy

**Never in my life would I expect to be cast as a president's “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down.**

It doesn’t end with these personal attacks either. With every new insult comes a horde of MAGA supporters, ready to pile on more death threats. Through Twitter. Email. Phone calls. Letters. You name it. With multiple people prosecuted for threatening to kill me. That NEVER happened before Trump.

There are days when the fight gets difficult. During the impeachment process. Serving on the January 6 Committee. When House Republicans censured me for doing my constitutional duty.

**But like I said on the House floor, I am honored by their enmity. I am flattered by the falsehoods they level against me. Those who were the authors of the big lie must attack the truth tellers and I am proud to stand accused. I wear their attacks as a badge of honor. Knowing that I have lived by my oath of office.**

My guiding principle has been serving in a way that will bring pride to my children. I believe that right and truth and decency matter now more than ever.

After long nights of consideration, I decided to run for California’s U.S. Senate seat. Because MAGA Republicans aren’t getting the job done and there’s too much that needs fixing. I have a record of getting tough things done, and I’m ready to do the hard work needed for our families, for our economy, for our democracy, and for our planet.

[**It’s clear Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans are going to do everything they can to sabotage my campaign — because they know how effective I am at gathering the truth, making a case, and holding them accountable. clean_body: | Peter— This is a more personal message than you generally receive from a campaign, but I wanted to pull back the curtain a bit why I’m in this race, and what the result will mean for our country. The last few years have been grueling for our nation and our democracy, but it hasn’t always been like this. There was a time before Donald Trump. When you could disagree without being disagreeable. When it wasn’t taboo to have friends across the aisle, or at least people you could work with. When you would bring people together — Democrats and Republicans — to get things done. Why? Because it was in the best interest of the American people to have a government that functioned. And that wasn’t in chaos 24/7. Those days feel long gone now. We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States. I’ve never been one to back down from the bad guys — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because it needed to be done. That vitriol has taken a turn for the worse. Here’s what the other side has had to say about me: “Wild-eyed conspiracy nut.” - Tucker Carlson “Pencil neck. Shifty Schiff.” - Donald Trump “[He] openly lied to the American public.” - Kevin McCarthy Never in my life would I expect to be cast as a president's “favorite” enemy — but here we are. And I’m not going to back down. It doesn’t end with these personal attacks either. With every new insult comes a horde of MAGA supporters, ready to pile on more death threats. Through Twitter. Email. Phone calls. Letters. You name it. With multiple people prosecuted for threatening to kill me. That NEVER happened before Trump. There are days when the fight gets difficult. During the impeachment process. Serving on the January 6 Committee. When House Republicans censured me for doing my constitutional duty. But like I said on the House floor, I am honored by their enmity. I am flattered by the falsehoods they level against me. Those who were the authors of the big lie must attack the truth tellers and I am proud to stand accused. I wear their attacks as a badge of honor. Knowing that I have lived by my oath of office. My guiding principle has been serving in a way that will bring pride to my children. I believe that right and truth and decency matter now more than ever. After long nights of consideration, I decided to run for California’s U.S. Senate seat. Because MAGA Republicans aren’t getting the job done and there’s too much that needs fixing. We don’t want to tell them how to live their lives – we just want to STOP them from forcing their way into our lives. I know you are a liberty-minded conservative. A true patriot who knows what's on the line if these Democrats gain more power in Washington. We can’t risk more out-of-control spending, higher inflation and prices, reduced gun rights and persecution for owning ammunition, skyrocketing crime and jailbreak policies that let violent offenders out on low or no bail days after their crimes, an illegal immigrant invasion and catch and release policies that prevent Border Patrol and ICE from deporting dangerous illegals and corrupt prosecutions of political opponents. Democrats have shown us what they have planned for America: DECLINE. Gratefully, Nancy Mace P.S. I know money is tight, but truly one dollar can make a difference in a campaign like mine because these races come down to the last minute and the last dollar. So, if you only have a dollar to spare, please know how thankful I am for your support, and I hope to continue to make you proud in Congress. | | About Nancy Congresswoman Nancy Mace grew up in the Lowcountry. She is the daughter of a retired Army General and retired school teacher. She is a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: I want to be transparent with you.
body:
Our fight for climate action, affordable housing, and reproductive justice all comes down to this, Peter.
Peter, I want to be transparent with you.
The next few weeks will be the most important weeks of our campaign.
On **June 30th** , we close the books on the final quarterly fundraising deadline of our primary campaign. **July 1st** is our last day to register voters, and the first early voting ballots go out on **July 3rd**. From that moment, we have less than four weeks to reach and mobilize voters before our super competitive primary election.
Our fight for climate action, affordable housing, and reproductive justice all comes down to this, Peter. Do we have the resources we need to reach every voter, get out the vote, and win our primary?

presidential election cycle.

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: A Special Message from Babylon Bee CEO Seth Dillon
body:
Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said:

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbvor201686og5crghb722p836nhpji8jucg5bfo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slhm1o72cth2bs)
---
|
---
Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg2bh1jiln3178d5jfu1lqqm0qbp7m3q9q0eupg8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slhm1o72cth2bs)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It’s clear to us that what the censors want is submission.** They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They’re asking us if we’re willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier.** ****Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.**** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers.** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zh4h3omcebcu0dn03gdl47nuraacpok1m1k4rul8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slhm1o72cth2bs)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z27goa5pvas2eqpu10jv0svtqhsk0d0c7396e9s0_rp22sh2s8i6ep34slhm1o72cth2bs)

Thanks for standing with us. We will continue to stand with you. Sincerely,Seth Dillon

| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e239b2314de54999936ecad0678c10b2&_e=4MDQXFvT4_9k3u0noLuUuc8UFx8fuq-Ju6PJSBYkPbKil6Mt3FuxOeg55iDV5a-GLaXH-MG4mvxn4DZ-gIHJIBJ30P9_lf8ER_skZ6fv3z76x9VMr_500L7cbAaRL_2uDzivNOLHZi45O3kzcgtfIsOszu2g9FAqffpuJmsV0kbI7_FxbcTyXeqUfEIqPrVRqx4FL2dvbuFgWRHcPkO6izJI-R9IuaEJf9YtlO5wRCjVX0xz6yDBRiTGv0zpcAqjE-LFTMsmlbqYo3Hp0uUNnw%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. There will be no censorship of humor." | | | | Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor." | | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, they censored my talk about censorship. It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us. "Profundity" was originally used to denote the vastness and depth of the ocean before the noun's meaning shifted to "depth of intellect, feeling, or spiritual mystery" in the 15th century. # FRIDAY, JUNE 28, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this day in 1939, Pan Am launched [the first scheduled transatlantic passenger flight](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GOrSAQANCvwU4DIyoWFK-xu6_d0syVQdkgGJjo7t9vsvV-wcn5eK0vDDGk_T-eZNnnFTcON61jC6YFverGWU8E1Ddk1aTmwYAyU3NYtb3nXm0K_Ixuku_BodFD73vlRiAzN8GCBC1HMEqCHIbOEPTv2Y8wSKM9zkJLcoFz6T5zSHyQj9_5ptJt-WyiPZivKvp_AhYBy_M83YUJzy6XXcBCX1fMBTnkVAUso1GtqtxywVSRIyYOW3thrZR2Kq2PYT-4KdZdT4gx1HESWu4nhvjL8d_528JPAAAA__91uF00) with the Boeing 314 Clipper, known as the Dixie Clipper, from Port Washington, New York, to Marseilles, France, with 22 passengers aboard. We had a spirited debate in the office about vacationing at the beach vs. a week in the mountains. Someone else chimed in that they enjoy camping in the wilderness. Let us know what type of vacation you prefer in today's poll. We hope you're enjoying each day's edition of _The_ _Flyover._ Let us know how we're doing by replying to this email.
|
---
## Biden Falters in CNN Debate
President Biden [struggled to communicate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u7CAQRp8GOlZ4wMAWFLdxt7dNaQ1mWE-Ef2QTr_L20aZO90lfcY7Ox2N8IFden_9xodjKNuLU-KLRKQgK7GhljoUIyEiKne_ufYAueDlHMpPJJmRIvUupR3Tg0fgCmAg8FskRNFjtIHQadN_fAoFJ9-Kg18EWvAurKXPbjtvnxmubqdTv7aLjNm2LrHFubT-F-SdgEDC0mWau9f0JGOZtoZVep4BhwmVHfq4CButtF1xQ7fhadpU406r2g873aIxVZUrYSL29VOWLBAzyiHl_ca18Oi-sfi7IvxTZ_u5xRfgJAAD__6OsYlg) clearly in last night's presidential debate, sparking criticism from both sides of the political aisle. Biden's voice was often quiet and raspy, and he stumbled over his words quite a few times--opening himself up to quips [like this](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FyhCAUAL8GunPgCU8oKNLQXdqUDspDyaDcKDG5v89c6rS7xc5-3Md7yCXvy3vYyLVUxzC3fNGINzA3UKPi0SUioJ6Tk4O02oA0A1_dnJJKyhoQcUgzaikxTCEiTlYHpIlnBwKUQDBSgNC6MwT9ZBOCFkalYJkSFHOrR_dZ895WSuVZLzq6uW68uLW1x8n6Nwaegf95UQY-7PF55mWvBzHwZwvt62TgpRGohdQojFJorOklA3_lSPVl-eHi4zuXkk8cmBLLFnL567T_ry8HvwEAAP__FgVWlA) from former President Trump: "_I really don't know what he said at the end of that sentence; I don't think he does either."_ The two candidates sparred over the economy, border policy, and abortion ([and even golf](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1TxCAUAH8NdJd5vPCVgsIGq7OxsMyQ8LjgkCOTYNR_75z1tbvFzn5cx2vIJd9vb2El11Idw9zySaO-oL2gHCWPLhEh9ZycMGJQFoU1fHGQIiCJqVfzPFmZKMzRGEE2iilRIJ4dAkrQaAUgKNVZwn4akkYFVqYwMAkUc6t791nzvS2Uym89ae_muvLilta2g_UvDD1D__OgDP17Idpof60lMfRHC-3rYOiFBa2ENDjgAKgVgGTozxypPizfXdy-cyn50IZJuK0hl_9Oe359OvwLAAD__33RVus)), but the substance of the debate was overshadowed by Biden's shaky performance. CNN's John King reported a "_deep, a wide, and a very aggressive panic in the Democratic Party"_ after the debate, and [reports quickly circulated](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuhSAUxvGnwU1zPALCwNDF7XbtaBAO954GxSi5pm_f2LnbN3zJL_l_PeaH58zb89Ov5Goqsw-V3zTrFk2LcpZNdIkIaWjI9WNvlcHejM3LWQIjPY1K2aUHq-UCNgygKQ6QBgkNOwSUoNH0gKBUZwiHxSaNCoxM3goJFLmWo_suvNUXpfxT3nR0oaxNdq9a91MMHwIngdN1Xd1eMlcO5T4InDa6ToHTrQicQN97FDgtHGlrI60lHL6e7UF79oFW2moL0GulR2wOF_eLc-ZTj0LCc_Wc_-D6f4a3w98AAAD__3MTXEE) of key Democrats calling for Biden to drop out. | Hi—

In case you missed it, **six** Supreme Court justices just overturned the long-standing Chevron Doctrine we told you about earlier this month—**and we have Big Oil to blame.**

The decision is a major blow to the power of EPA and other expert agencies, and the millions Big Oil spent to influence this decision is all part of their desire to pollute more by undermining climate progress.

Evergreen is committed to doing everything we can to call out the six oil-drenched justices on the Supreme Court and to keep fighting for federal agencies to take urgent, ambitious climate action—**but we don't have the kind of funds that Big Oil does.**

[**Will you rush a donation of $5, $10, or more right now so that we can take this fight to the next level?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2655845/87SdQ4wZ) |

Date: Thurs, Jun 13, 2024
Subject: Dark money, SCOTUS, and Big Oil: It's all connected |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2655847/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

The Supreme Court is about to deliver the Big Oil-backed Koch network a big win later this month—**here's what you need to know and what we can do about it.**

The **Chevron doctrine** (also called Chevron deference) has been used for decades, directing courts to defer to the experts at federal agencies when interpreting complex or unclear laws.

Now, the Supreme Court is about to release a ruling that could kill or limit this commonsense practice.

And **this has a huge impact on climate** and many other issues you may care about. It'll allow rightwing, climate-denying judges to step in with their own legal interpretations, no matter what the experts at agencies like the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) say. |
---
[SHOW ME WHAT THIS MEANS FOR CLIMATE](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2655848/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **How we got here :** This case has Big Oil's fingerprints on it all the way through. They helped Donald Trump stack the court with a bunch of corrupt justices, brought the sham case being used to overturn Chevron, paid for the lawyers arguing the case, and are close to their goal of undermining EPA and other agencies' ability to do their job.

**Where we must go :** There is a way we can take back the court and advance democracy and climate action. [We dive deeper in our latest blog.](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2655849/87SdQ4wZ)

This web of dark money and power used the Supreme Court to shift power away from technical experts to themselves—corporate interests.

**It's time we—the public—fight back.**[**Read our latest to find out how.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2655850/87SdQ4wZ)

Onward, |

body:
Elon Musk the "Chief Twit" sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c584051b98634c2e89edef3294d2ff4d&_e=QXKFzrfOL4H1e9JJz7lZQ9muNt9IRc_F7pfxFoEpZi0NHZUakMzZenXzxD3BX4L-g6ogP-3JWFvPsGY26T1gYMDjTEBaghHxnx4N_ffkdjWydx4S_2W74XeUjHumYFTFG7sagYDEZYPDTURSE0qavnM5IThIjUnM6-3biMdD-mfIzr6Gs1YIsctdcoC5OSHwnGAEku8SSGXb0LQZ4IX2mHAUibUur4HI2jRoa2QHCpWRtpTEYHdU3Ft8kGTCNWosp0jboA3XvyLF1jjguSe3Qw%3D%3D)

Friends, Not long ago, Elon Musk bought Twitter, changed his bio to Chief Twit, and sent me a DM that said: "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c584051b98634c2e89edef3294d2ff4d&_e=QXKFzrfOL4H1e9JJz7lZQ9muNt9IRc_F7pfxFoEpZi0NHZUakMzZenXzxD3BX4L-g6ogP-3JWFvPsGY26T1gYMDjTEBaghHxnx4N_ffkdjWydx4S_2W74XeUjHumYFTFgWZ45rhW99lUDmqMCUCuHOKgr6pIONY54Xo8Es9rldk2o4wmwaCLxSgpVxNdWd_oSQ6zISD40u3dyUbp74537ZqFstaBGWNAiCotHZwZyKhVAZ1BIR9wBVnKUJTS1CMH2_vi9PsYnYzUQBZphmpSnw%3D%3D)
---
| | We've been trying to think of a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But as resourceful and committed to free speech as he is, Musk is still just one man, and X is just one platform. Censorship remains the law of the land on virtually every other social media site run by Big Tech. X is a welcome but rare exception. Just a couple of months ago, I was notified that the conservative David Horowitz Freedom Center was permanently suspended by Vimeo for posting a talk I'd given about censorship. Just think about the irony of that for a second. As if they wanted to make my point for me more emphatically than I ever could, **they censored my talk about censorship. ** **It 's clear to us that what the censors want is submission. **They want unquestioning conformity. They want us to give up and start fighting. Stop telling jokes. Stop telling the truth. They want to raise the cost of speaking freely so high that we'd rather just keep our mouths shut to avoid all the hassle and penalties. They're asking us if we're willing to silence ourselves just to make things easier. ** ** **Our answer to that is NO. The truth is worth it. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us.** ** ** Of course, that's easier said than done. Standing against the censorious Left takes resources. I can tell you right now, The Babylon Bee would not have been able to take the stand that we did against Twitter if it hadn't been for the support of our subscribers. ** ** That's our safety net. That's what gives us the confidence to fight back against big tech without being afraid of them putting us out of business. They can hurt us. Sure, they can reduce our reach and smear us in the media, but they can't shut us down. We have our supporters to thank for that. **I hope you'll consider joining the fight by****[**becoming a paid subscriber to the Babylon Bee.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c584051b98634c2e89edef3294d2ff4d&_e=QXKFzrfOL4H1e9JJz7lZQ9muNt9IRc_F7pfxFoEpZi0NHZUakMzZenXzxD3BX4L-g6ogP-3JWFvPsGY26T1gYMDjTEBaghHxnx4N_ffkdjWydx4S_2W74XeUjHumYFTFUneAckB_fTFQ7bIGIanxUorvoDw3U4fid0zg34uYeTy8vYhZMYwCLvz634oA7orJHP_dJM3IzRG15FgyzgX8yzKcbPX4ED9nqpZtgQpaLPJIiRmmHuMdXb36_HhT4rtmt9JHC77pcO9dnorapS2cSQ%3D%3D)** ** ** But don't just support us. Support defenders of freedom wherever you find them. Subscribe to X Premium to support Elon. Ditch Disney and subscribe to the Daily Wire. Back anyone bold enough to say what's true, even if it comes at a cost. Especially if it comes at a cost. They'll be that much more fearless and that much harder to stop if they have a whole army of freedom-loving subscribers at their backs.
---
[**YES, I'LL STAND WITH THE BEE**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c584051b98634c2e89edef3294d2ff4d&_e=QXKFzrfOL4H1e9JJz7lZQ9muNt9IRc_F7pfxFoEpZi0NHZUakMzZenXzxD3BX4L-g6ogP-3JWFvPsGY26T1gYMDjTEBaghHxnx4N_ffkdjWydx4S_2W74XeUjHumYFTFivbVU6Vvb0Uo1olGNbSk2WFuTwGZYUQUoNDRRpHbmKIpoevqaf4PEy4kcwjyAwA6WdAYBH86IIoZxJocdqTuYOW2wGBiN9TFlKDcy-EsnvMgxMsrY27oIFikA3d7RrT7f6Fxt2m2wY7P3yjxRfmGOg%3D%3D)

* I’m the America First conservative and political outsider running to defeat 50-year career politician Shady Sherrod Brown in **Ohio’s toss-up U.S. Senate race.**

* **President Donald Trump won Ohio in 2016 and 2020** , making it one of our best chances to flip a seat red in 2024.

* Democrats have a 2-seat majority, which means **we MUST flip Ohio** in order to restore a Republican majority that can work with a Trump White House to get our country back on track.

* **President Trump has endorsed my campaign** , and it’s been my privilege to campaign alongside him.

* The latest polls show Brown with a **5% lead** , just outside the margin of error.

* Brown is also leading _**ALL U.S. SENATE CANDIDATES**_ in fundraising, making ours one of the biggest challenges to overcome.

I hope you understand _**we have no choice**_ but to win this seat in Ohio. _But I’m behind_ – both in polling and fundraising.

I can’t win in Ohio unless I receive the same support _(or more)_ from you and our conservative grassroots base that Sherrod Brown is from his leftist base.

Thankfully, we still have time to catch up. _But it’s going to take all of us pulling together!_

**Please show your commitment to delivering a Republican Senate majority for President Trump in 2024 by following his lead and sending support to our campaign.**

While watching the first Presidential debate last night, I reflected on the sage wisdom imparted by one [Sally Claire](https://substack.com/redirect/3256d0b5-9536-4490-a551-3846d80439d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on effective journalism:
> If someone says it's raining, and another person says it's dry, it's not your job to quote them both. Your job is to look out the f*cking window and find out which is true.
It appears neither Jake Tapper nor Dana Bash got that memo. I watched the absolutely disgraceful spectacle of CNN moderators who refused to fact check Trump (or Biden) on anything, refused to separate fact from fiction, and refused to take a stand that truth matters. Their inactions amount to journalistic malpractice, and such journalistic apathy is truly decimating our democracy. And it wasn't just that they failed to fact check the candidates--their own questions were infused with flat out lies.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=146068522&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2MDY4NTIyLCJpYXQiOjE3MTk1NzYwODksImV4cCI6MTcyMjE2ODA4OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0._GtX67KgpYtmmfVlgPglhJzRZQdZR7HNK0oEIfUVxuc)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d83d3780-3772-4f03-87d9-70dfa680fefd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Joe Biden and Donald Trump at CNN's Atlanta studio, on Thursday. Photograph: Brian Snyder/Reuters
For example, despite knowing there's no such thing as "post birth abortion," Dana Bash asked a question insinuating there is. Likewise, despite knowing [Netanyahu himself is rejecting the UN ceasefire resolution](https://substack.com/redirect/b49cf542-cc5f-492b-9dd3-6759630b194b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), she blamed Hamas. Jake Tapper wasn't any better. Despite previously and personally confirming that Donald Trump said Nazis are "very fine people," he allowed Trump to lie repeatedly to his face that he said no such thing. Likewise, despite Tapper previously and personally confirming that Trump disparaged soldiers who died in combat as "suckers and losers," he again allowed Trump to lie repeatedly that he said no such thing.
Democracy apparently dies on primetime television.
Donald Trump continued his assault on truth. Regarding migrants, his demonization of immigrants as "criminals" was appalling and devoid of facts. Immigrants, including undocumented immigrants, [have lower crime rates than US citizens](https://substack.com/redirect/9df4fb20-b35d-4237-a690-34dae20f7f4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). There aren't "criminals" pouring in and there's no evidence of it. Him placing the blame for drug trafficking on immigrants is also contrary to reality. In [fact](https://substack.com/redirect/021bf006-eeb9-4f5a-9bd3-2381b22d2533?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), 86.3% of drug trafficking is by US Citizens, only .02% of people Border Patrol arrested for crossing illegally possessed any fentanyl at all, and annual deaths from fentanyl doubled from 2019 to 2021 after US Government banned asylum. In other words, his own terrible border policies excacerbated the fentanyl crisis.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..OLK_bf84tpq5U-9Dekl_Yg9MV5mvdAHFgSGrxAKPnxs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146068522)
But Trump's xenophobia and lack of personal responsibility didn't stop there. He took particular effort to [transform Palestinian into a slur](https://substack.com/redirect/7175bc2d-7d7a-419d-832a-fc5e2a8097d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), calling Biden a "Palestinian, a bad Palestinian." This was an apt summary of the dehumanizing discussion around Israel and Gaza. As mentioned earlier, Bash used a lie to bash Hamas for allegedly rejecting the ceasefire resolution, when in truth it is Netanyahu rejecting the binding UN Security Council ceasefire resolution. To my surprise Bash remarkably mentioned that thousands of Palestians have been killed and there is famine in Gaza, but as I predicted, there was no mention of Israel's war crimes, secret torture camps, ICC, ICJ, and UN charges of extermination, stopping aid to Gaza, or Israel's own admitted plans to [annex the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/af6a24e1-ab3f-4dfc-929c-5ad4184dac77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On climate, Donald Trump refused to acknowledge the reality of climate change, and instead lied that his administration cares about the environment. In reality, his administration saw a decimation of the EPA, a repeal of hundreds of environmental regulations, a withdrawal from the Paris Climate Accords, and a removal of efforts to limit reliance on fossil fuels.
On democracy itself, Trump was asked three times to affirm, yes or no, that he will accept the result of the election, win or lose. Each time Trump refused to answer Yes. And true to form, the CNN moderators ultimately refused to call out his non-answer, instead simply moving on to the next question. The same was true when Trump repeated the debunked claims of "partial birth abortion" and "post birth abortion." Tapper and Bash simply moved on as if Trump commented on the weather, when in reality his dangerous rhetoric has enabled the repeal of reproductive rights, and led to a [deadly spike in maternal and infant mortality in states like Texas](https://substack.com/redirect/49253ec7-d5bd-451f-97eb-14e635c3bcf9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
President Biden didn't do himself any favors by claiming Border Patrol endorsed him (they didn't), or by claiming no servicemembers died during his presidency (13 have), or by trailing off repeatedly in the middle of making a point.
One of the most frustrating moments for me was the debate over their golf handicap. Wealth and income inequality is at historic highs, 78% of Americans live paycheck to paycheck, housing, healthcare, and childcare is unaffordable, American tax dollars are funding a literal genocide, and the two men campaigning for the most powerful government office on Earth used their time on stage to argue--in all seriousness--about their golf handicap. This is not how you win voters, activate disaffected voters, or show you are in touch with the hurt countless Americans experience on the daily.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..OLK_bf84tpq5U-9Dekl_Yg9MV5mvdAHFgSGrxAKPnxs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146068522)
A second Presidential debate is scheduled for September, but politicians like South Carolina Senator Lindsay Graham are already suggesting that Trump cancel. It might make for good strategy, they argue, for Trump to let this debate be the last lingering memory in the minds of voters. That said, media outlets are now starting to [call out Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/8852eb7f-82a1-42fc-bf66-8cb04878b674?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for his grotesque lies and that could backfire for him. Likewise, several in media including New York Times columnist Nicholas Kristof are calling for Biden to withdraw from the 2024 election and allow the Democratic Party to nominate a new duo for the November election.
Time will tell what develops.
For now, one thing is for sure. We're facing the real threat of falling into fascism, and far from even having the journalistic responsibility to "look outside the f*cking window," we suffer debate moderators hurtling our democracy down that bottomless pit. In last night's debate, between breathtakingly incompetent moderators, a perennially lying Donald Trump who refuses to say he'll accept the results if he loses, and a President Biden unable to articulate his point in any effective sort of way--there were no winners, only losers.
Namely, the American people and the hopes of a functioning democracy.

It might make for good strategy, they argue, for Trump to let this debate be the last lingering memory in the minds of voters. That said, media outlets are now starting to for his grotesque lies and that could backfire for him. Likewise, several in media including New York Times columnist Nicholas Kristof are calling for Biden to withdraw from the 2024 election and allow the Democratic Party to nominate a new duo for the November election. Time will tell what develops. For now, one thing is for sure. We're facing the real threat of falling into fascism, and far from even having the journalistic responsibility to "look outside the fcking window," we suffer debate moderators hurtling our democracy down that bottomless pit. In last night's debate, between breathtakingly incompetent moderators, a perennially lying Donald Trump who refuses to say he'll accept the results if he loses, and a President Biden unable to articulate his point in any effective sort of way--there were no winners, only losers. Namely, the American people and the hopes of a functioning democracy. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. clean_body: Let me introduce myself| | | Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military. I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again.But my new mission is a little different. I'm now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self. I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending. But today, career politicians like Tim “Hillary” Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent. Now, I'm stepping up because we need a change. I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians. We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. I'm not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. I'm asking humbly: Answer this call to duty with me and let's get America back on track. # **It's Far From Over**
---
| | | | Hi folks, It's been a while since you last heard directly from me; the past few months have been incredibly busy. I wish I were reaching out under better circumstances, but we don't always get to choose how things unfold, do we? Last night, I received messages from dozens of reporters, senior staff, major donors, and even friends and family seeking insider information. That's not how this works. There are no hidden strategies being crafted behind the scenes. The debate didn't go well, but there is no discussion yet about the President stepping away from the nomination he overwhelmingly secured. I won't sugarcoat it—it was a poor performance, but it's not unprecedented for an incumbent president to stumble in the first debate. Remember Trump's first debate as an incumbent? It was a disaster. Even President Obama struggled in his first debate against Mitt Romney. As I finally turned off my phone and settled down last night, I thought about how our work impacts the national conversation. It's more important than ever for us to focus on the critical work we're doing across all three branches of government. The presidency isn't the only crucial position at stake in 2024. There are many winnable battles with excellent candidates who deserve our support. To achieve these victories, we need your help. I am mindful of the fact that last night's performance was both disappointing and discouraging for Democrats across the country. However, we must also be mindful of who and what we are up against. We are facing a Republican party with a terrifying vision for the country, a vision that contradicts core American principles. The public overwhelmingly supports our message over the MAGA alternative, which is why we need to work towards amplifying our message as much as possible before November 5th. The 2024 election is far from decided, and MAGA remains a threat to our government and institutions. Defending the Senate may be the key to stopping them. Our work in the coming months is vital, as the fight to protect the Senate will be incredibly challenging. Support in times like these is what can fuel a grassroots movement toward making a real difference this November, and No Dem Left Behind is ready to take on this challenge. Together, we can ensure our vision for the future prevails. Thank you for your continued support, Hassan Martini

We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT:
Frail, Weak-Voiced Biden Struggles During Primetime Debate with Trump as Deteriorating Mental Fitness Was on Full Display (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/frail-weak-voiced-biden-struggles-during-primetime-debate-with-trump-as-deteriorating-mental-fitness-was-on-full-display.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=a97c5ca482-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

By Illinois Review
A visibly agitated, confused and low-energy President Joe Biden, who spoke in a raspy whisper, struggled during the first presidential debate of the 2024 election cycle with former President Donald Trump – appearing confused and angry at times – as the ailing president’s deteriorating health was on full display during Thursday’s 90-minute debate.

During the 90-minute debate, Biden coughed several times and appeared frail – sparking even more concerns as an overwhelming majority of Americans remain worried about Biden’s mental fitness to handle the job as president.

In 1988, then U.S. Sen. Joe Biden suffered two life-threatening brain aneurysms that required life-saving surgery, and many health experts, including former White House Physician and U.S. Rep. Ronny Jackson believes that as a result, Biden suffers from long term damage. “The press should be asking the president’s physician – tell us what the consequences of those two brain aneurysms were and do they have anything to do with what we’re seeing today?” A few days ago, Jackson called for Biden to take a drug test before the debate – a call that was ignored by Biden and his team.

During the debate, Trump said he “aced a cognitive test” and challenged Biden to take a similar test, but the ailing president ignored the question and instead focused on challenging Trump to a game of golf.

The highly anticipated discussion focused on issues facing everyday Americans: high inflation, the skyrocketing cost of groceries, the southern border, the migrant crisis and foreign policy. Trump also pushed the issue of a weaponized justice system and accused Biden of targeting a political enemy as the president called Trump a “convicted felon.” The comment drew an immediate response from Trump, who reminded Biden that his son was a “felon” – a point that left Biden stunned and speechless.

**Are you wondering if you're one of us, the common folk? Here are five ways to determine if you are:**
1. You're concerned about working until you're well into your 90s because you have little to no money saved for retirement.

2. The cost of living continues to rise, and your wages can't keep up.

3. Your children are facing a tougher path than you did in affording a home or attending college.

4. Taking time off work or seeking medical care feels like an unaffordable luxury.

5. If you feel your freedoms are being stripped away - whether it's women's bodily autonomy, voters' rights, social security, or public education.

**Let's face it, the system isn't designed for us, the common people.**
I am one of us, a common person, and I'm determined to go to Washington to work for us.

You're concerned about working until you're well into your 90s because you have little to no money saved for retirement. 2. The cost of living continues to rise, and your wages can't keep up. 3. body:
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
#
]
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240628-1-160&refcode2=2549.734936._K0iTC&t=1&akid=2549%2E734936%2E_K0iTC)

Hello, Peter. This is Ken Burns.
As a filmmaker, I've always been deeply interested in the moments that defined the American spirit — the Civil War, the Great Depression, the Second World War, the Vietnam War, the Civil Rights Movement.
These were inflection points where we were forced to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
As Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
Today, we face a new generational challenge. Our system of government is in great peril. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It has never been more important that we come together to ensure that our republic endures for future generations.
To meet that challenge, we need leaders who understand how important our democracy is and what it truly means to serve. That's why I’m writing to you on behalf of Ruben Gallego. Ruben is the son of immigrant parents, the first in his family to go to college, a Marine veteran, and a father.
His opponent, Kari Lake, attacks our elections at every turn. She sows the very same discord that is tearing our country apart. She is dangerous. Where Ruben would unite us, Kari Lake seeks only division.
We need more people like Ruben serving our country, and it would mean the world to me if you could support his campaign.

Folks-
Last night proved what we all already know; there is only one moral, competent choice in this election; and it’s not the convicted felon.
President Biden took Trump to task on his reckless hypocrisy and dangerous rhetoric and perfectly made the case for four more years of progress, innovation, and protection of the rights of all Americans.
The comparison could not have been more clear. President Biden used his time on the debate stage to speak directly to the American people and proved that he cares about our future, our health care, our education, our economy, our safety, our veterans, our military, our allies, and all of us . Meanwhile, Donald Trump further proved he is unfit for the presidency by implying he’s not even proud to be from the country he wants to lead.
Peter, Joe Biden has held up his end of the bargain for the last four years by fighting to deliver for the American people. Now it’s our turn.
Will you join Democrats across the Commonwealth in committing to giving this election your all and showing President Biden that you’re ready for four more years? Now more than ever, we need you in this fight.
Rush a donation to President Biden to provide crucial aid in our fight to protect democracy and reject conservative attempts to move our country backwards.
Donate to President Biden today! [https://secure.joebiden.com/a/new-england-bvf-2?attr=113220542]
We’d also like to invite you to join us on the campaign trail. We’re asking that you give us some of your time between now and November to volunteer in whatever capacity you are capable to spread the mission and vision of the Biden-Harris campaign far and wide.
Your fellow Democrats in New Hampshire have asked that we help them in their mission to reach as many voters as possible, whether through knocking on doors or making phone calls. Find opportunities here [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1r-uOy4PLmM5LGhi-IqnTlv6ghjdg1J0hh2oNDVWB_vk/edit] .
We’re proud to support President Biden, and we know that we have the momentum to keep the White House and move our country forward. Let’s get to work.
Onward,
The Massachusetts Democratic Party

[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240628-1&t=2&akid=1590%2E135344%2En1TB8d)
---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails before this FEC deadline, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $3 or whatever you can to my campaign before our FEC fundraising deadline ends this weekend.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240628-1&t=3&akid=1590%2E135344%2En1TB8d)**

Friend,

It should be common sense for a Senator from a border state:

_**Border security is national security.**_

**New Mexico’s border is the most-wide open in the United States; we make the whole country vulnerable.**

_But far-left Democrats like Martin Heinrich don’t think so._ Millions of illegal immigrants are flooding across our southern border, and Joe Biden and Martin Heinrich’s policies encourage them to keep coming— not just from Mexico, but from Communist China, India, and Central America.

Since Biden took office, it is estimated that more than 6.7 million migrants have entered our country illegally through our southern border—that is the equivalent of three times the population of New Mexico!

It’s a slap in the face to New Mexicans, and it’s a slap in the face to all Americans who are forced to live with the dangerous and expensive consequences of their misguided approach.

[**This is one of the many reasons I’m running against Heinrich for U.S. Senate in New Mexico, and why it’s so important that I have your backing in this critical fight.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ff6eac9d9ef84cb78fd5907c06c59322&_e=OXXLuWtUNoooOc41kuY6iYerL-a3zLrunsphv7fALVKIpes4iTjIlP9GTq_2CPubf_VNORmJjbkh5xotpSuPNoj3LorzSg5wl-8d6cKMl_8faj2G-qRgO1a5VQ3sXKYI6D0qkyJ2UFN8MINgmrJDOPfBLQVKZvgLJNYSe00H1dCGJIRxukD4ylzGaGk0Kgz1_ZyiXWYLZC1NXn9vuvB6CTZe3mEkVUqk3jxtOKL9Jy1usgRxd6eH84XfB3TiI4YoS6uLOvhkpxKM-ZLzMaSR6riYo2vTabiqh-wCfasR1lzR_6fX_B4vC2gHLXrcfkhgW4TXT5jUiZzqZg2_eSMT4DjXifxd6drVAXxxeXYxSm24Z3bHjp1CUsUNlWDQkxvWnteE-BlCCXqTcGEhqXId-hrA8t4j-K4SlqO93aYAeAolf1pZCbublTUju2o0p2ZG)

[ ** SECURE THE BORDER NOW **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ff6eac9d9ef84cb78fd5907c06c59322&_e=OXXLuWtUNoooOc41kuY6iYerL-a3zLrunsphv7fALVKIpes4iTjIlP9GTq_2CPubf_VNORmJjbkh5xotpSuPNoj3LorzSg5wl-8d6cKMl_8faj2G-qRgO1a5VQ3sXKYI6D0qkyJ2UFN8MINgmrJDOPfBLQVKZvgLJNYSe00H1dCGJIRxukD4ylzGaGk0Kgz1_ZyiXWYLZC1NXn9vuvB6CTZe3mEkVUqk3jxtOKL9Jy1usgRxd6eH84XfB3TiI4YoS6uLOvhkpxKM-ZLzMaSR6itAfvmgh1Kj-aAHYhEZmE85OJiY3HOf4gE19LJ-70m5m6F7rVlpGor9Zb1_aS8bijVMIPzv3NRw00167VheTSW6g2Q1ZLvdpPm8_lsBAO4Rz7hrST0qajsmp86vzJdWiVjZxqI1L7rBwHlO7U7QKkoxkt2E303XBBtmIqsAN94v)
**First** , Martin Heinrich voted against _BIPARTISAN_ immigration reform and opposed crucial border security funding.

**Then** , he supported Joe Biden’s reckless executive orders that invited _MILLIONS_ of illegals to flood our border.

Hi Friend, There are plenty of issues that members of Congress need to address: women's reproductive rights, healthcare, inflation, the economy, immigration, the environment, education.... There's a lot that Congress could be doing for all of us. But, *I* wouldn't have thought "putting a racist, antiquated pro-Confederacy memorial back in Arlington National Cemetery" was one of them. My MAGA opponent John Carter feels differently. [If you're ready to help send John Carter packing, please join our movement with a contribution today. Whether you can give $5 or $500, it all adds up for our people-powered movement to win back the House majority.](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001l6dSeeCjGZK92OSLcwYGd6rDq4uddnBURY37rUgDLEn7d-RYSNFv5NiBESQkxWm9oBVlXuw1hEff86PD7GX6djKv5GJJGNnwd4jLNCNlmRqQFLMv06tFqPREQ7BiK6G_Vk2Ty7EiR_BLgxu6-ZJsYDxQggBo4g8LSRsQvsB6z7x77C4BlxPf9ti7Lq7OXa5QAoPzDakpBMtPQmzKibU_Fg==&c=MdmvqHPRo6EVLdN9290czVIookSLQl-Xetj7Y34tLAZo4kYxI6QccA==&ch=sR1MbqhIjP2LSG7YNh0uk-FM7LvksYefbpdrJ9ZzmOEkJDGYjjh6LQ==) Need to hear more...we've got the details: The Confederate Memorial in question -- the one that's John Carter is so fixated on -- was removed from Arlington National Cemetery last year by the Office of the Army, the military organization that's responsible for maintaining and operating national cemeteries like Arlington. Why was it removed? The statue was first commissioned by the United Daughters of the Confederacy to honor the "dead heroes" who had taken up arms against the United States. Among the figures it depicts is a black slave following his white owner as the owner heads off to war. Apparently this was intended by the sculptor to correct the "lies" told about black slaves' support for the Confederacy in Uncle Tom's Cabin. Somehow this overtly racist and pro-Confederate memorial stood on the same hallowed ground where we've buried so many of our war heroes--soldiers and sailors who died serving the United States of America, not the Confederate States of America--for decades. Finally, the memorial was removed last year when it finally dawned on the Defense Department that it might be just the slightest bit inappropriate. (Worth noting however: the decision to remove the racist statue didn't require the involvement of any member of Congress). But like the folks who still shout "the South will rise again," the supporters of racist dog whistles like the Confederate Memorial didn't give up. That includes 192 members of Congress--people like John Carter--who just voted to put the Confederate Memorial back in Arlington National Cemetery. Let me say that again: John Carter, along with 191 other members of Congress, voted to put a racist, pro-Confederacy memorial back in Arlington National Cemetery. Even they seem to have felt a little guilty about this: The proposal refers to the Confederate Memorial as the "Reconciliation Memorial," so that they didn't have to use the C-word (*Confederacy) in their proposed legislation. Fortunately, that proposal failed when 230 other members of Congress said "thanks but no thanks." I'm grateful other members of Congress stood up to John Carter and said NO. A racist, pro-Confederacy memorial has NO place in any of our national cemeteries, let alone Arlington National Cemetery. But I'm also concerned about what this says about how Congress uses its time. Are there seriously no more important issues that our elected officials can think of than whether to reinstall an antiquated and offensive memorial in Arlington? Where's the legislation addressing immigration? Or inflation? Or healthcare costs? Or a hundred other things that matter more than this monument? People are justifiably concerned at the inability of Republican leaders to draft or pass meaningful legislation. And when we say "do something," we don't mean "do something about the Confederate Memorial." It's past time to focus on issues that actually affect us. And that starts by replacing extremist John Carter with someone who hasn't lost focus on what really matters. [I can't take on the MAGA movement here in Texas without folks like you. Defeating MAGA Republicans like John Carter is going to take all of us. Will you pitch in now -- whether it's $5 or $500 -- so our team can defeat John Carter and help Democrats win back the House majority?](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001l6dSeeCjGZK92OSLcwYGd6rDq4uddnBURY37rUgDLEn7d-RYSNFv5NiBESQkxWm9oBVlXuw1hEff86PD7GX6djKv5GJJGNnwd4jLNCNlmRqQFLMv06tFqPREQ7BiK6G_Vk2Ty7EiR_BLgxu6-ZJsYDxQggBo4g8LSRsQvsB6z7x77C4BlxPf9ti7Lq7OXa5QAoPzDakpBMtPQmzKibU_Fg==&c=MdmvqHPRo6EVLdN9290czVIookSLQl-Xetj7Y34tLAZo4kYxI6QccA==&ch=sR1MbqhIjP2LSG7YNh0uk-FM7LvksYefbpdrJ9ZzmOEkJDGYjjh6LQ==)

clean_body: It's time to get Congress back on track. | | | | == | == Hi Friend, There are plenty of issues that members of Congress need to address: women's reproductive rights, healthcare, inflation, the economy, immigration, the environment, education.... There's a lot that Congress could be doing for all of us. But, I wouldn't have thought "putting a racist, antiquated pro-Confederacy memorial back in Arlington National Cemetery" was one of them. My MAGA opponent John Carter feels differently. == Need to hear more...we've got the details: The Confederate Memorial in question -- the one that's John Carter is so fixated on -- was removed from Arlington National Cemetery last year by the Office of the Army, the military organization that's responsible for maintaining and operating national cemeteries like Arlington. Why was it removed? The statue was first commissioned by the United Daughters of the Confederacy to honor the "dead heroes" who had taken up arms against the United States. Among the figures it depicts is a black slave following his white owner as the owner heads off to war. Apparently this was intended by the sculptor to correct the "lies" told about black slaves' support for the Confederacy in Uncle Tom's Cabin. Somehow this overtly racist and pro-Confederate memorial stood on the same hallowed ground where we've buried so many of our war heroes--soldiers and sailors who died serving the United States of America, not the Confederate States of America--for decades. Finally, the memorial was removed last year when it finally dawned on the Defense Department that it might be just the slightest bit inappropriate. (Worth noting however: the decision to remove the racist statue didn't require the involvement of any member of Congress). But like the folks who still shout "the South will rise again," the supporters of racist dog whistles like the Confederate Memorial didn't give up. That includes 192 members of Congress--people like John Carter--who just voted to put the Confederate Memorial back in Arlington National Cemetery. Let me say that again: John Carter, along with 191 other members of Congress, voted to put a racist, pro-Confederacy memorial back in Arlington National Cemetery. Even they seem to have felt a little guilty about this: The proposal refers to the Confederate Memorial as the "Reconciliation Memorial," so that they didn't have to use the C-word (*Confederacy) in their proposed legislation. Fortunately, that proposal failed when 230 other members of Congress said "thanks but no thanks." I'm grateful other members of Congress stood up to John Carter and said NO. A racist, pro-Confederacy memorial has NO place in any of our national cemeteries, let alone Arlington National Cemetery. But I'm also concerned about what this says about how Congress uses its time. Are there seriously no more important issues that our elected officials can think of than whether to reinstall an antiquated and offensive memorial in Arlington? Where's the legislation addressing immigration? Or inflation? Or healthcare costs? Or a hundred other things that matter more than this monument? People are justifiably concerned at the inability of Republican leaders to draft or pass meaningful legislation. And when we say "do something," we don't mean "do something about the Confederate Memorial." It's past time to focus on issues that actually affect us. To win, it was clear that I had to engage with voters one-on-one. So, I printed flyers on my home computer, laced up my jogging shoes, and knocked on the doors in my district. By talking to people on their front steps about their daily lives and hearing their struggles, I learned how I could best represent them. I won because I listened. As the son of a union millwright and the first person in my family to go to college, I know why it's so important to have representatives who listen to, understand, and stand up for regular folks and push back against the powerful and privileged. When I look at the field of GOP Senate candidates across the country, I see ultra-wealthy MAGA Republicans writing checks from their personal fortunes to fund their campaigns against grassroots Democratic opponents. body:
[1]Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate

Peter — I’m a born-and-raised
Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54253?refcode=em20240628-5880&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=5880%2E614464%2EN24tc4 ]Photo of Andy with his kids.

I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. But if you
give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree
— [ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54253?refcode=em20240628-5880&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=5880%2E614464%2EN24tc4 ]and I hope you’ll then chip in to help Lucas Kunce defeat Josh Hawley
this November.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54253?refcode=em20240628-5880&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=5880%2E614464%2EN24tc4 ]CHIP IN NOW

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition
to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley
does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not
married — just gay.

While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections
for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his
assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with
reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you
reading this.

Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to
build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and
rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women
gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be
forever indebted to them.

My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just
a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can
tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails.
Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs
associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always
either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an
immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be
a right.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54253?refcode=em20240628-5880&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=5880%2E614464%2EN24tc4 ]St. Louis Public Radio headline: 'No protection for IVF' Missouri
advocates sound alarm after IVF safeguards stymied in legislature.

Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less
freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF
shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has)
that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.

And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley
— who is now up for his first election since everything changed.

You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and
how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work
in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide —
[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54253?refcode=em20240628-5880&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=5880%2E614464%2EN24tc4 ]and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat
Hawley in November, then add a donation to help Lucas get it done.

[ https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54253?refcode=em20240628-5880&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=5880%2E614464%2EN24tc4 ]CHIP IN NOW

But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal

ANCHORAGE, AK - As our nation celebrates the second anniversary of the
Supreme Court overturning Roe v. Wade and the return of abortion
policy-making to the states, pro-life, pro-woman candidates are
storming ahead into political offices. Today, one of those premiere
candidates, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom, was endorsed by Susan B.
Anthony Pro-Life America in her run for Congress.

"I am honored to receive Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America's
endorsement. Our children are our future, and we must protect the most
vulnerable among them - the unborn," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said
in a statement. "As your congresswoman, I will work to protect the
sanctity of life while also promoting pro-woman policies in Washington."

body:
Another term with Donald Trump in the White House means we’d have another four years of a president who encourages political violence.
#

During last night’s presidential debate, Donald Trump called the people who attacked the Capitol on January 6, 2021 “peacefully patriotic.”
Does this look peacefully patriotic to you?
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240628-1-30&t=1&akid=8399%2E3935704%2EGOHa2F)(Photo credit: Leah Millis - Reuters)
Let us be very clear: the people who attacked our nation’s Capitol are insurrectionists. On that horrific day, rioters brought enough bullets into the Capitol building to shoot every member of Congress at least five times.
Those insurrections stormed the Capitol with an intention to harm our elected officials.
Political violence and gun violence go hand in hand. Another term with Donald Trump in the White House means we’d have another four years of a president who encourages political violence.
President Joe Biden has already proven that he is willing to fight for gun safety. From signing the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ into law and creating a federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention, it’s clear that finding commonsense solutions to our gun safety epidemic is President Biden’s priority.
Meanwhile, Donald Trump—with his constant lies and vitriol—has shown time and time again that he is unfit to lead our nation and unwilling to do anything at all about our gun violence crisis.

[firstname, Patriot], If you didn't watch the debate last night, I'm sure you heard about it. I've said before that this administration is sleepwalking us into a third World War, and while I meant it figuratively, as I watched Joe Biden's performance last night, I think it may also be true literally. We cannot get President Trump back in office soon enough. Joe Biden is not fit to be our Commander-in-Chief, not fit to be responsible for the "nuclear football," and definitely not fit for another four years on the job. Biden's presidency has been one of the greatest hardships our country has faced - from inflation and the economy to the open border and the fentanyl trafficking it enables to the erasure of women's athletics by biological men. But he didn't do this all on his own - he did it with the backing of other elected officials, especially my opponent Marie Perez, who has voted for and funded Joe Biden's policies every step of the way. Joe's got to go, and Marie has to go, too. Help me make that a reality by donating to my campaign at [JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/KtsfXeo1zP892VehwZUHTxJw/Igx2x9iMcTBt041fgC1Fxg). Joe Kent P.S. Joe Biden has been a disaster for our country, and Marie Perez has been one of his top allies enabling him in Congress. Joe's got to go, and he can take Marie with him. body:
I am old fashioned, but on the substance Joe Biden won the debate last night. That is what matters to me.

Folks, Listen.
I am old fashioned, but on the substance Joe Biden won the debate last night. That is what matters to me.
All this other talk... it's unhelpful and unnecessary. We aren't going to turn our backs because of one performance. What kind of party does that?
Don't look at 30 minutes... look at 3 and a half years of Joe Biden as president. It's been a master class: 15.6 million jobs created — 8x more than the last 3 Republican presidents combined; gun safety legislation; lowering the cost of prescription drugs; an infrastructure package to rebuild this country.
Joe Biden has delivered — and we need to deliver for him in this moment. We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now.
That's what I intend to do, and I hope you'll join me.
Make a contribution to the Democratic National Committee today. They can use the resources to make sure we not only beat Trump this November, but elect Democrats up-and-down the ballot in key races everywhere.

Peter,

It should be common sense for a Senator from a border state:

_**Border security is national security.**_

**New Mexico’s border is the most-wide open in the United States; we make the whole country vulnerable.**

_But far-left Democrats like Martin Heinrich don’t think so._ Millions of illegal immigrants are flooding across our southern border, and Joe Biden and Martin Heinrich’s policies encourage them to keep coming— not just from Mexico, but from Communist China, India, and Central America.

Since Biden took office, it is estimated that more than 6.7 million migrants have entered our country illegally through our southern border—that is the equivalent of three times the population of New Mexico!

It’s a slap in the face to New Mexicans, and it’s a slap in the face to all Americans who are forced to live with the dangerous and expensive consequences of their misguided approach.

[**This is one of the many reasons I’m running against Heinrich for U.S. Senate in New Mexico, and why it’s so important that I have your backing in this critical fight.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a5e2632395b1423a8b2bd6f752e94683&_e=27M238c2N7d_d2gXMoJ_DZ7q8MkY7-JpvkwdWDPNtNJE5a1d1cU3MNVUj2WRYqg-7PXHAI7WRCestIzvaKy3R32Dpq48z6k6i0Fu5sL5EEm996lItTC6kxDp529k3szNSMe5VLqynK4jueKpY0cnE7DULI9CzWTkMA5JVg9lTFf1QGDBwAtSQud3wGzFJm5bQ7kdi7CYXPwQqUC9z_r5j0xLOoNHDmfUyZVJe3blhidpXXBFFsSHcVk5C_xMfx6sTTh_ePtarAvxa2s9W7tC7B5a5Q8E_OCRbqcinNb8IWa5zcO5zmUdqt_1RmQLkQpk32ipW3b3L5o9PL6-HaLpJGXNXVGmfKkMj_ePkN_MtQX7hftl7f5vzkDKsFFK1sxXKZBxZ4LPTPvb94cdf2845PYUfEJNIyoo4J4Ednv8cvJDtxmxh_tVPgGxpJbKFfek)

**First** , Martin Heinrich voted against _BIPARTISAN_ immigration reform and opposed crucial border security funding.

**Then** , he supported Joe Biden’s reckless executive orders that invited _MILLIONS_ of illegals to flood our border.
