A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=378123605b724358bf873ec2b1d2adb6&_e=iYhq_gggVxSTlf1fDjENjwNF0H9D8r8ncsS9IqLFecJ_IALcDwDbcZrerVFdyHGotyHdzBYCgnNFnxfFTRum7E8N-R7L0u0FYsOpbDr03BMkVBCWcXaNZA-PH0SW_SOkMkUR7wZdT2HyV6j_LLfY7zWjbAeyE1B9Abs-F3NCwSZ5R7s-s0qfSYTW17G9f12P567L4SWcbBggF5o7lXFj1yHbPqO7_Piym8avxAu2zddPLCk0Rqxedpu9Plkn9k2c_sX2NLyl8BJ1PZUrS32BkDVeWemHvC0jD7P2iPGq-iO5bw4rZMaOsfCQpuZSjfktFgPwXbTh-AY4ao8Up6f0RVbtxtxrX7pQB8jmJRyZitvHX9U7V3w00ISfSQevibOE0avEUrQFO4D6PWgw1fY6iw%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.eaglecoalition.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=378123605b724358bf873ec2b1d2adb6&_e=iYhq_gggVxSTlf1fDjENjwNF0H9D8r8ncsS9IqLFecJ_IALcDwDbcZrerVFdyHGotyHdzBYCgnNFnxfFTRum7E8N-R7L0u0FYsOpbDr03BMkVBCWcXaNZA-PH0SW_SOkMkUR7wZdT2HyV6j_LLfY7zWjbAeyE1B9Abs-F3NCwSZ5R7s-s0qfSYTW17G9f12P567L4SWcbBggF5o7lXFj1yHbPqO7_Piym8avxAu2zddPLCk0Rqxedpu9Plkn9k2cYcA3NKGrlebBz2970iuxG9HPLutpkJPj8kMwU4kkzphdcHAkBnfLClVjSSLq7QFHzMuyeMPrQvPVVcVh1d1eCtfRhAIhrWXosE4dxNO8YUG-IgYWd8XRfj5OeXjxtnsKmOIjOKZn7W6_IlSFhXHdxw%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: Be careful what you wish for. I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. _**Obamacare isn’t affordable healthcare. Republicans should put patients and doctors back in charge**_ By Bobby Jindal and Newt Gingrich _Biden and Democrats have failed with healthcare by using a Big Government approach_
---
The American people are waking up to President Joe Biden and the Democrats’ healthcare failures.

Recent polling by America’s New Majority Project, a project of Gingrich 360, shows that 59% of voters say healthcare has become more expensive under Biden, 59% say health insurance has become more expensive, and 50% say prescription drugs have become more expensive.

In fact, Americans believe that reelecting Biden will increase health costs. Most Americans expect healthcare to become more expensive under a second Biden term, a considerably larger percentage than the number who think it would become more expensive under a second Trump term.

Clearly, American patients know the government-centric approach of Obama and Biden isn’t working to make healthcare affordable. It is time to return to the approach that has made American healthcare great: putting patients and their doctors back in the driver’s seat. **[](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=f8ad673ab7254290932c3ba7b3d07934&_e=CuGglZdl2tynckCXH3tDZNeOzjZZ6Jg3TGhJsZXRMwufjCGqD8Ksv51Z-MDyzN1Fvv5chm4U5QKH-dUIa_L4_R74zfR_fbNG9HueSY0FP-E_HF28bLK5xP-uJr08A4DzNuTEloDlloSP-6PZE2HJjcID4z2gVctKtjfuqcrqxEXQ0_8l2CNa1sHp_dkjNEx940gd26IZw6H4NLKiqgLAoC_KzGEaf8fCPZDRIV2Qd9iZgPnYwXAx0p6uU69tvkTF)[FINISH READING ON FOXNEWS.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=f8ad673ab7254290932c3ba7b3d07934&_e=CuGglZdl2tynckCXH3tDZNeOzjZZ6Jg3TGhJsZXRMws1qYUtMqz31lXfqQ-omKvNQyCQCfdaUX8A6A2O7ccsTAlbazTyXvrJVD5iPETUUdRdeaROpa8E9k9qZpSWGxP5Eibo5bFwAAckD2CeKAdDQp6M8m97Argpz_LCe0N5ebLFarONzNTV2JSUwKXpxbsTEiKO9WLZpCfUkd-C-jtx804Fgj7uagXG3FyB7VqGYZ0WrFgt_c9uxLnPtHK4_6B7Kq_d8VgJ37Rj1Fe5XVrlhXj_kTK0Bk9JJ1xCGmhH3ej2UBk9iEnSSMRGQ-pAkXzdI0_7m5w3MC8eDFCZv0hQ7w%3D%3D)**

| From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Dear Fellow Patriot,

We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c944d4c217e04eb4808458393e080887&_e=8NbBSFfTdd1MFlh7XCtMspFDngNdvaaVz1MDW1QR_GcmibASSFIuOjaaEIGtLg9tLz46Dznaya-zqQMv7LMrIxqBEMw9plh3feoqwnYvhyzbRJnk13K-V6_oE1xBZEZkX9ZbASXZ-ml7XQ_4e_SqADmZWV_DCmX900UseB0hr3nlXPAN_2gISGtTcx4C_7QgSq5CKmONw9ezggZRQMswLgXtnzWbplAYhd7a_3TUtJml7MCZuUfKJH4a2rDrptshZ6SCETuD2_z8n-rqNsrLMnZhmuwk11TJa3zqEnNjSYPiJQKw4qJ7EIUT-Jh51T4J7XJ0rjspa5cTGrKPURIWVtokAc-wYtwTrTWs78tWXssxmkv_ozcG4WIDaCwEtEhHsZD4ecGdhaE0OrfGm416Rg%3D%3D) Your gift of $100 or more to ACI today will help strengthen the bonds of our communities by lifting up the virtues of faith, liberty, community, and life.

Will you give today to support these cornerstone principles? They are essential to the success of our nation--principles that can be bolstered immeasurably and immediately by strengthening our families. To show my appreciation for your gift of $100 or more, you will receive an advanced signed copy of my new book "The Perilous Fight: Overcoming Our Culture's War on the American Family".

And to help pass down these important pillars to the next generation, I'lll also send you a free copy of my children's book "Why America Matters" that celebrates our great country and reminds us what a blessing it is to be an American.

You can make your secure gift here: [https://secure.americancornerstone.org/the-perilous-fight](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=c944d4c217e04eb4808458393e080887&_e=8NbBSFfTdd1MFlh7XCtMspFDngNdvaaVz1MDW1QR_GcmibASSFIuOjaaEIGtLg9tLz46Dznaya-zqQMv7LMrIxqBEMw9plh3feoqwnYvhyzbRJnk13K-V6_oE1xBZEZkX9ZbASXZ-ml7XQ_4e_SqADmZWV_DCmX900UseB0hr3nlXPAN_2gISGtTcx4C_7QgSq5CKmONw9ezggZRQMswLgXtnzWbplAYhd7a_3TUtJml7MCZuUfKJH4a2rDrptshNaKIYPh4ih9_23Lq6QwFZUttAg_DEqQi4rumcGX02jHnB5ESLebTGuKgbEQfP-cgZwhy7WHp6piaLMDDfMHypn2QCBOzzaoyZj7wVE7Lrs3l02MkuXjGKha9AKgiPZMHDSIpTXOabPYyGUi_NIVGBA%3D%3D)

Thank you for your interest in preserving and strengthening America's families!

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

I'm a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines disarming explosives with seconds to spare and performed some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military. I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after my father was put on the Vietcong's kill list. If it wasn't for American freedom, I probably wouldn't be here today. I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again.But my new mission is a little different. I'm now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self. I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending. But today, career politicians like Tim “Hillary” Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent. I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians. We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. Answer this call to duty with me and let's get America back on track. body:

Hello Derek,
Jamie Lee Curtis here.

Today is Freaky Friday — but not for the reason you might think.

We are approaching a critical moment in Adam’s campaign for the U.S.
Senate: the June FEC Quarterly fundraising deadline.

Why is this deadline so important? As we are less than five months away
from our November election, Adam’s GOP opponent has been ramping up his
fundraising efforts — raising almost $5 million in the last quarter alone
— and we need to make sure Adam has the resources and time needed to
respond.

Because this deadline is so critical, if you feel like you don’t need to
read any further, you can join Adam’s grassroots team right now by
chipping in here: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em.GGnUBV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240628_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6855%2E5257348%2E_w0RgP ]secure.actblue.com/donate/june2024_abs_em

As a lifelong Californian, I’ve witnessed the work that great public
servants can do when given the opportunity. And I know that given the
opportunity, Adam will be a real champion for the environment, for
reproductive freedom, and for our democracy, if elected to the Senate.

Lately, many of the politicians who are supposed to be representing us
only care about their next 15-second news-making moment or working to
advance their own interests. Adam knows he works for us, not the other way
around — and he will go everywhere and do everything all at once for the
people of California.

Adam has never backed down from supporting the fight for our country’s
democracy, and protecting our rights and freedoms, no matter what has been
thrown at him. No amount of name-calling from Donald Trump will stop him.
Or attempts to censure him in Congress. Or conspiracy theories propounded
against him on Fox News. He keeps fighting.

With the very real threat of Trump being elected as President, it’s more
important than ever to have strong defenders of our democracy and our
freedoms, ready to fight back in the U.S. Senate.

I’m supporting Adam in this race for all of these reasons and more, and I
hope you’ll join me in this fight.

Folks, the Supreme Court issued a decision today that overturned the _Chevron_ doctrine, which has been the cornerstone of the EPA’s environmental protections for 40 years. **This decision is a major setback for the environmental protection movement.** It strips federal agencies like the EPA of their power to regulate based on science and expertise and hands it over to unelected judges. These judges lack the necessary knowledge, but now they have the final say on complex issues like air pollution control and clean water policies. | [**FIGHT BACK**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87822313/482365823/-1987279562?refcode=ea.b541eaa4-9635-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.b541eaa4-9635-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI1NDFlYWE0LTk2MzUtZWYxMS04NmQyLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=coFFUu2CJ9ECtJbxX_n1n6aS-wSjmOw6a8J2_HHWe30=)

**It's exactly what big polluters and greedy corporate executives have been dreaming of — fewer regulations and more freedom to damage our planet.**
But let’s be clear: We’re not backing down. This decision is a call to action. We need to fight harder, louder, and more united than ever before to elect bold climate champions who will hold greedy fossil fuel giants accountable and push for strong, effective environmental policies.

MAGA-extremist Rep. Jack Bergman isn't serving everyone. We need a consistent and fair representative who will advocate for all of us.
https://www.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://www.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
We have just a few days to hit our grassroots fundraising goal so we can get a representative to DC who will fight for all hardworking families in the district. Friends, can you chip in tonight?
https://www.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://www.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
RUSH A CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
Friends,
In a press release today, Rep. Bergman highlights his support for permanently raising federal wildland firefighters' pay from $15 to $25-$35 per hour, including paid healthcare and pensions, enhanced mental health support, and housing stipends.
"If firefighters can't support themselves and their families financially, we can't expect them to support our communities," he said.
Great! Yes. But what about the rest of the District? He's so close to understanding the problem but just doesn't get it.
I share Rep. Bergman's support for firefighters, but we need to take it a step further. The need for fair compensation for all workers is not just important, it's urgent. This is a cause that we must all rally behind.
We all deserve the ability to support ourselves with full-time employment and livable wages.
The scale of the problem is not just significant; it's staggering. Over half of full-time workers in Michigan's 1st District earn less than $25 per hour, and 27% earn less than $15 per hour. With about 337,000 employed individuals in this District, it's clear that around 178,000 workers are struggling to make ends meet.
That is why I am running for Congress: to help all of us, not just a select few, for your families, your freedoms, and your future.
Join our fight for economic mobility for everyone. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julyad]
-Bob

body:
And every Michigan family.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1285%2E62735%2EnYCRhM)
I was scrolling through my photos last night, and I just had to share this one, Peter:
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/790?t=2&akid=1285%2E62735%2EnYCRhM)
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1789?t=3&akid=1285%2E62735%2EnYCRhM)**
It’s one of my all-time favorites from the campaign trail: my son Pierce, perched up on my shoulders (one of his favorite places to be), during the historic United Auto Workers strike last year.
As a single father, my whole world revolves around Pierce. Adopting him is the single greatest decision I ever made — his laughter is my joy, his dreams are my aspirations, and his future is my driving motivation. Every morning I drop him off at school, I’m reminded of the responsibility I bear as his father to shape a world that nurtures, protects, and empowers him to be his best self.
**Peter, I truly believe in a better Michigan — and I’m running for U.S. Senate to deliver it not just for my own son, but _your_ kids, too. **
I want them to grow up in a world where healthcare is a fundamental human right, where workers are treated with dignity, and where the toxic influence of money in politics is overpowered by the will of the people. Their collective future hinges on the decisions we make today, and I can promise you: As Michigan’s next Senator, I’ll make every decision, every vote, with our kids’ futures in mind. I’ll fight like hell and work with Democrats, Republicans, Independents — whoever it takes — to deliver progress on the issues you care about.
**_But I can’t do it alone._**
[**We have less than 40 days until the primary, and it’s going to take ALL of us working together to win this election. So, I have to ask: Will you please chip in $5 _today_ to fuel our people-powered campaign?**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1783?t=5&akid=1285%2E62735%2EnYCRhM)

Democrats are only as strong as our most vulnerable incumbents
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38949%2E3422442%2EphlYj4)
Derek,
On November 5th, 2024, we’ve got a real shot at flipping the House blue. But we can’t do it unless we defend our most vulnerable incumbents. **Here in California, that means protecting my good friend Josh Harder.**
Josh is facing one of _**toughest** _races of any Democratic incumbent in the state. In his primary, he won 49.7% of the vote—and the remaining 50.3% went to Republican candidates. Now, a recent poll has Josh down 4 points to his GOP opponent.
Like me, Josh doesn’t take a cent from corporate PACs. He never has. And like me, he’s a leader in the fight to get corporate special interests out of Congress because he supports banning corporate PACs completely.
But he won’t be able to keep up that fight if he loses in November.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to consider splitting a donation of $5 between Josh’s campaign and my organization, Truth to Power, today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240628-harder?refcode=em20240628-38949&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38949_3422442_phlYj4&akid=38949%2E3422442%2EphlYj4)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240628-harder?refcode=em20240628-38949&refcode2=38949_3422442_phlYj4&akid=38949%2E3422442%2EphlYj4)
We can’t flip the House without holding onto tough seats like this one. The math just doesn’t work out. But Republicans have set their sights on Josh—and their corporate backers are already getting ready to spend serious money to try and flip this seat red.
On Sunday at midnight, Josh has a critical end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. The good news is that if he can hit his fundraising goal before then, he’ll be in good shape to fight back. And if we hold this seat, then our odds of flipping the House go way up.
**[So, is there anything you can give?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240628-harder?refcode=em20240628-38949&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38949_3422442_phlYj4&akid=38949%2E3422442%2EphlYj4)**

Thanks so much for your help. I deeply appreciate it.
—Katie

Friend,

I'd like to take a few minutes to tell you about my story.

My name is Mariannette Miller-Meeks and I have the pleasure of being the current Congresswoman of Iowa's 1st Congressional District. I am running for re-election to Congress because the people of Iowa deserve someone who will never quit fighting for them, their future, and the future of their American dream. As a Congresswoman, state senator, military veteran, and doctor, I have spent my entire life fighting to protect Iowa values.

Growing up, life wasn't always easy. My father, who was a Master Sergeant in the United States Air Force, often had to work multiple jobs to support our family. My mother, who only had a GED, had to work and raise our family as well. My parents taught me lessons of hard work, kindness, and love for country. I've taken what I learned from them throughout my entire life.

I always thought I wanted to be a teacher because I loved school and wanted to share my passion for learning with others. However, in 10th grade, my younger brother and I were severely burned in a kitchen fire. While at the hospital, I was treated by a physical therapist who went out of her way to make sure I got better. This woman's kindness and selflessness inspired me to become a doctor so I could help others.

I was the fourth of eight children with parents who did not have the means to pay for college. I left home at 16 and enrolled in community college. I later enlisted in the US Army at 18, going from Private to Lt. Colonel during my 24 years of service. I went into private medical practice in Ottumwa in 1997. My husband Curt and I have two grown children, Jonathon and Taylor. It's been one of my joyous achievements to raise two wonderful children with Curt.

In 2018, the voters of Senate District 41 elected me to fight for them in the Iowa State Senate. In 2020, I was elected to Congress by a six-vote margin, one of the closest races in United States election history. Then, in 2022, the voters of southeastern Iowa elected me again to fight for our values in the U.S. House of Representatives.

In Congress, I've been a conservative fighter for you. I work tirelessly to lessen the economic burden on you and your family, secure our border, protect our streets, and provide every child with opportunities for quality education. While life hasn't always been easy for me, my Christian faith has helped guide every decision I make. It's been the honor of my lifetime to serve as the Congresswoman for the First Congressional of Iowa. **[I humbly ask for your support so I can continue fighting to protect Iowa values.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=09a42fe91be94c0587e38f6b4941f506&_e=WrKEx5bsM2s4x7xANkiquGfTQA4psNvdGBQRPpV4nsKHpqBNqnlDV88X5SyBXAfvSzu7_ARp683CqiX65bOxFEjmEUsCDw-opiWZPT9PZIj7_fg_Hn6-UpnkqEPnDHrlazpk6nCu7CUjYyQCH4qqsOePYVP-J7j-jtjiQF9iERVf57JrrvNg3MXvjMqLErQle2U96WnyZ71mFiWC-boceWt6iflr6NYM1zfA7y7XfDeMQsVzk6qehc_ZJ9uFGX63Sr2YG1rcxK8Dsfdd6xO9SNLYpD1y8hDpCYnxPD9lCSPNSyiKJAktqTPbqCyV9k7bLVSOhS2BpOC_aeJsA2GwAXmY9Bm6Nh-hl6fgZ4mVKgI3741QHJ9aMPlrIAqtObRMnoQ3Bz1_ZmTnHfuzWyLau2Th6KiHOYI1A6egcuEEglM%3D)**

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.

---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Happy Friday,
Welp, that was quite the show last night, folks. Below we have some articles that recap the debacle... but I'm curious, how do you think it went? What were some of the moments that stood out to you the most? Reply to this email or on X/Twitter [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)!
This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, June 28, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**['A good free-for-all': Weld County crowd reacts to first Biden-Trump debate meeting of '24](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
HUDSON -- Just a jog down the road from where a rancher long ago installed two, giant pro-Donald Trump billboards in his pastures, the Republican Women of Weld met Thursday to cheer on the former, and they hope future, President.
A capacity crowd in the backroom of Ben's Pizza supported Mr. Trump, with applause and often laughter, as he took on President Joe Biden in their first debate meeting of the year.
A bingo game with predictable phrases that might be uttered didn't last through the first commercial break, but the crowd lasted through the 1-1/2 hour debate in which largely Mr. Biden and Mr. Trump took turns criticizing each other's policies, and their golf games.
"I'm happy it was civil," said Dan Woog, a state representative in District 63. "I think it was pretty clear the economy is a big issue for Trump. I do think Biden came ready."
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Biden, Trump spar over inflation, border, more in first presidential debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* During the first presidential debate, President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump clashed over key issues like inflation, illegal immigration, and abortion, with Trump critiquing Biden's coherence and Biden accusing Trump of lying and having poor morals.
* Trump boasted about his presidential term's economic successes and minimal wars, while Biden defended his economic policies and promised to restore federal protections for abortion, which Trump opposed.
* The debate, moderated by CNN's Jake Tapper and Dana Bash in Atlanta, also saw Trump criticizing Biden's border policies, claiming they endanger Americans and strain entitlement programs.
* Trump defended his actions on January 6, claiming he had promoted peace and attempted to deploy the National Guard, which he said was refused by Nancy Pelosi and Muriel Bowser.
* The debate sets the stage for the upcoming major political conventions and another presidential debate scheduled for September 10.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Supreme Court sides with Jan. 6 defendant against obstruction charge](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Supreme Court invalidated the use of a 2002 law to charge Jan. 6 protesters, including former President Trump, with obstruction of the Electoral College count, stating the application was overly broad.
* Led by Chief Justice John Roberts, the decision impacts hundreds of cases, clarifying that Congress did not intend such a broad application of the law.
* Justice Amy Coney Barrett's dissent argued the law was meant as a "catchall" for various obstructive behaviors.
* The ruling specifically overturned the conviction of Joseph Fischer, who briefly entered the Capitol during the Jan. 6 events.
* Attorney General Merrick Garland noted that most Jan. 6 charges are unaffected but the DOJ will review cases involving the obstruction charge.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Evans to Weld Women:'We can win the 8th District and retire Caraveo'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Gabe Evans, the Republican nominee for Colorado's 8th District, expressed confidence in defeating incumbent Democrat Yadira Caraveo, criticizing her positions on key issues like border control, energy, and agriculture.
* After a decisive 55-point victory in the Republican primary, Evans is backed by significant financial support, with the National Republican Congressional Committee investing $2.327 million into his campaign--its third-highest nationwide investment.
* The 8th District, designed for competitive races, is a major focus for both parties, with Evans citing Caraveo's record as a vulnerability.
* Additional funding of $5.1 million supports Evans' campaign, while Caraveo potentially has about $7 million for her re-election bid.
* Recent polls show Evans slightly ahead of Caraveo, with a 1% to 5% lead, signaling a competitive race ahead.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Harsanyi: Biden just put on most disastrous debate performance in Presidential history](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Sure, it might sound like hyperbole, but I can 't think of a more devastating presidential debate performance than the one Joe Biden had in his first meeting with Donald Trump. Indeed, even with abnormally low expectations, Biden tripped over them as if they were sandbags. After watching post-debate reaction, it's safe to say no modern presidential debate has ever rattled a political party quite like this one._
_The scratchy and frail voice. The speedy mumbling -- it was like watching a TV at 2x speed. The overall incoherence. The confused and angry stares. The jumbling of thoughts --"I was recently in, in, in, um, France for D-Day, and I spoke to -- all about those heroes that died ..." and so on -- was relentless. It was difficult to watch._
_Recall, as well, that Biden 's team, down in the polls, pushed for this debate. Remember that video the president cut mocking and challenging Trump to face him? The Biden team reportedly fought for the strict rules implemented by CNN. Then the president took an entire week off from his job just to prepare for the contest. Letting him debate was political malpractice. Letting him run for the presidency is a dereliction of basic decency._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Devotional: Where did God come from?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Have you ever found yourself captivated by God 's existence? It's a question that has intrigued and perplexed many, regardless of their religious beliefs.
_ _
__Let 's momentarily set aside religious texts and embark on a journey of contemplation. Whether you are a devout believer, a skeptic, or somewhere in between, I invite you to delve into a fresh perspective on this timeless question. Imagine this - a serene drive through the Fort Morgan, Colorado, cemetery, with my curious granddaughter Lilly in the backseat. At this moment, she asked, "Papa, where did God come from?"_ __

Below we have some articles that recap the debacle... but I'm curious, how do you think it went? What were some of the moments that stood out to you the most? Reply to this email or on X/Twitter ! This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, June 28, 2024. - Heidi Ganahl | | | TODAY'S TOP STORIES HUDSON -- Just a jog down the road from where a rancher long ago installed two, giant pro-Donald Trump billboards in his pastures, the Republican Women of Weld met Thursday to cheer on the former, and they hope future, President. A capacity crowd in the backroom of Ben's Pizza supported Mr. Trump, with applause and often laughter, as he took on President Joe Biden in their first debate meeting of the year. A bingo game with predictable phrases that might be uttered didn't last through the first commercial break, but the crowd lasted through the 1-1/2 hour debate in which largely Mr. Biden and Mr. Trump took turns criticizing each other's policies, and their golf games. "I'm happy it was civil," said Dan Woog, a state representative in District 63. "I think it was pretty clear the economy is a big issue for Trump. I do think Biden came ready." | During the first presidential debate, President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump clashed over key issues like inflation, illegal immigration, and abortion, with Trump critiquing Biden's coherence and Biden accusing Trump of lying and having poor morals. Trump boasted about his presidential term's economic successes and minimal wars, while Biden defended his economic policies and promised to restore federal protections for abortion, which Trump opposed. The debate, moderated by CNN's Jake Tapper and Dana Bash in Atlanta, also saw Trump criticizing Biden's border policies, claiming they endanger Americans and strain entitlement programs. Trump defended his actions on January 6, claiming he had promoted peace and attempted to deploy the National Guard, which he said was refused by Nancy Pelosi and Muriel Bowser. The debate sets the stage for the upcoming major political conventions and another presidential debate scheduled for September 10. | Supreme Court invalidated the use of a 2002 law to charge Jan. 6 protesters, including former President Trump, with obstruction of the Electoral College count, stating the application was overly broad. Led by Chief Justice John Roberts, the decision impacts hundreds of cases, clarifying that Congress did not intend such a broad application of the law. Justice Amy Coney Barrett's dissent argued the law was meant as a "catchall" for various obstructive behaviors. The ruling specifically overturned the conviction of Joseph Fischer, who briefly entered the Capitol during the Jan. 6 events. Attorney General Merrick Garland noted that most Jan. 6 charges are unaffected but the DOJ will review cases involving the obstruction charge. | Gabe Evans, the Republican nominee for Colorado's 8th District, expressed confidence in defeating incumbent Democrat Yadira Caraveo, criticizing her positions on key issues like border control, energy, and agriculture. After a decisive 55-point victory in the Republican primary, Evans is backed by significant financial support, with the National Republican Congressional Committee investing $2.327 million into his campaign--its third-highest nationwide investment. The 8th District, designed for competitive races, is a major focus for both parties, with Evans citing Caraveo's record as a vulnerability. Additional funding of $5.1 million supports Evans' campaign, while Caraveo potentially has about $7 million for her re-election bid. Recent polls show Evans slightly ahead of Caraveo, with a 1% to 5% lead, signaling a competitive race ahead. | Sure, it might sound like hyperbole, but I can 't think of a more devastating presidential debate performance than the one Joe Biden had in his first meeting with Donald Trump. Indeed, even with abnormally low expectations, Biden tripped over them as if they were sandbags. After watching post-debate reaction, it's safe to say no modern presidential debate has ever rattled a political party quite like this one. The scratchy and frail voice. The speedy mumbling -- it was like watching a TV at 2x speed. The overall incoherence. The confused and angry stares. The jumbling of thoughts --"I was recently in, in, in, um, France for D-Day, and I spoke to -- all about those heroes that died ..." and so on -- was relentless. It was difficult to watch. Recall, as well, that Biden 's team, down in the polls, pushed for this debate. Remember that video the president cut mocking and challenging Trump to face him? The Biden team reportedly fought for the strict rules implemented by CNN. Then the president took an entire week off from his job just to prepare for the contest. Letting him debate was political malpractice. Letting him run for the presidency is a dereliction of basic decency. | Have you ever found yourself captivated by God 's existence? name: AOC
subject: It's not up to us to love only parts of people.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
There is a long history in this country of weaponizing religion to justify bigotry.
White supremacists have done it. Those who justified slavery did it. Those who fought against integration did it.
**And we’re seeing it today with the unprecedented attacks on the LGBTQ+ community.**
I am tired of the only time religious freedom is invoked is in the name of bigotry and discrimination. It is not up to legislators to deny medical care.
It is up to us to feed the hungry, to clothe the poor, to protect children, and to **love all people as ourselves**.
This Pride Month, we’re standing up for two grassroots community organizations who are defending LGBTQ+ rights, empowering our most vulnerable, and providing young people with a safe space to flourish.

We hope you’ll read his message below, and then split a donation between his and Jason’s campaigns. But truthfully, this race is much bigger than Virginia’s 7th district, or you and me.
It’s a fight to end the hateful MAGA regime that wants to control our lives, play politics with our classrooms, ban reproductive freedom, and serve their party over the people who elected them.
It’s a fight to return true leadership, integrity, and commitment to our country back to the People’s House.
It’s a fight to defend the very future of our democracy, and the stakes have never been higher.

body:
Joe Biden and Bob Casey are career politicians who have failed us.
[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=d0efa4a4bb94446289f070c0166db624&_e=XKYOTpdbTnHJ_tTOQfp_OFXYoF3ZKWLQmFx-nzwmYnV4wFG2lENJYOHYjLGvJnWKbxeqV4E1wYX6iqGYwN8a9uecDDnq3bfdbMLFELjDgltDFaUSwqwa_E0ZB3jUFlZDMZjGIVftbmYSzB0VGk0WTcjg0KdoZHuWRiW9id0_oZYuS2OfXWTp6jJSl-jbgvyRcXgaejCBeRQ1ste1L_I8tKEgOvInns7TnAY0JH7thhCm2wQ31htOjm2mlbW4HJRkRTxF6gwt_CBbozi4KodNnn_chEKp3yG-y8U0A9WaHHdneiGsgFGuWfszU2k7_Al91LSw6IPaZlDD1CWLQoke9vsFSWWv4WWPEl2caVp7t8lplH7L7_IJ-rkQYOyRtMCv_J-IGq0Z0bGPgkK8ux4zdw%3D%3D)

Fellow American,

The debate was hard to watch. The American President was either lying, mumbling, or speaking incoherently throughout the entire night. I don't know how anyone could watch and continue to think Joe Biden is fit for office.

## **I Need Your Support [Critical Deadline]**
---
Hi Peter,You are on this email list because you support my candidacy to become the representative for TX-27. Whether you are from Bastrop, Corpus Christi, or somewhere in between, you have seen me working tirelessly for our community, our state, and our collective future wellbeing. Your support means the world to me, and it’s what drives this campaign forward.[**Now, more than ever, I need your help.**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=667f47d1ec5f0363bd28763a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Ftanyafortx27&w=658f0ec36f3fe00284167a1e&c=b_667f445b4f3fe313638f3ba3&l=en-US&s=eonM_M7pe7mr7b_CIilub0UBVWA%3D) Through this campaign, I aim to achieve significant advancements for our community. My vision includes:
* **Improved Public Education:** Supporting programs that uplift underserved youth, invest in K-12 students, and improve college affordability.
* **Protect Reproductive Rights:** Michael Cloud wants to get between women and their doctors. We must codify Roe v. Wade into law.
* **Address Our Rural Healthcare Crisis:** Invest in ensuring all communities have the healthcare services they need, including our rural communities.
* **Strengthened Democracy:** Protecting our democratic values and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
* **Economic Growth:** Strengthen economic well-being of the working class and middle class families, including much-needed infrastructure investments.

These goals are not just lofty promises; they are concrete steps that will improve people's lives in substantial ways. But, to make this vision a reality, I need the resources to push our campaign forward, especially since my opponent is MAGA extremist Michael Cloud.[**There are less than three days to donate before the most crucial deadline of this campaign.**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=667f47d1ec5f0363bd28763a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Ftanyafortx27&w=658f0ec36f3fe00284167a1e&c=b_667f445b4f3fe313638f3ba3&l=en-US&s=eonM_M7pe7mr7b_CIilub0UBVWA%3D) The public reports on what we raise together by the June 30th deadline will shape the narrative of this race against Cloud. My goal is to establish myself as the clear leader – the progressive candidate ready to represent our community and bring about real change.[**Please consider making a donation today. We are incredibly close to reaching our $30,000 goal, and every dollar counts.**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=667f47d1ec5f0363bd28763a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Ftanyafortx27&w=658f0ec36f3fe00284167a1e&c=b_667f445b4f3fe313638f3ba3&l=en-US&s=eonM_M7pe7mr7b_CIilub0UBVWA%3D) With your help, I am confident we can achieve this milestone and demonstrate the strength of our movement.Thank you for your continued support. We’ve seen the consequences of a Trump White House. He set the stage for dismantling Roe v. Wade with a conservative Supreme Court majority and fanned the flames of division leading to the January 6th insurrection.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: A recap of this year’s legislative session
body:
I’m thinking back on all the incredible work we did to improve the lives of our neighbors up and down the state.
#
As this year’s legislative session in Dover comes to a close, I’m thinking back on all the incredible work we did to improve the lives of our neighbors up and down the state.
Since the first day it started, it’s been an incredibly busy session. From healthcare to gun violence to abortion rights and so much more, we’ve worked hard to deliver in so many areas. Here are some of the highlights:
* We passed the _Protect Medicaid Act of 2024_ through the Senate, my bipartisan legislation to secure the **largest ongoing investment in our state’s Medicaid program** since the Affordable Care Act. With two days left, I’m hopeful it will pass the House before the end of session.

* We also passed the **most important gun safety bill** of my entire time in the legislature. Requiring a permit-to-purchase a handgun will do more than any other bill to curb the kind of gun violence we most frequently see in our state.

* We **protected reproductive rights** and made sure every insurer in the state — whether private or Medicaid — will cover medication abortion.

* Finally, I’m personally proud that the Senate passed my bipartisan legislation to make permanent a program that **funds auto insurance for youth in foster care.** This program has already helped dozens of youth gain more independence, and I’m glad to see it’s on its way to being made permanent.

I was elected to the State Senate to make a difference for my neighbors, and that’s exactly what we tried to do this session. **With your support, I’m ready to continue the work in Congress.**
[**But, I can’t get there without your help. So if you’re ready to help prove to the entire country that small states can do big things, will you pitch in $5 today to help my campaign reach our end-of-quarter fundraising goal before Sunday’s deadline?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240628-2?refcode=em20240628-2-724&amount=5&refcode2=724_21716_Xy04pQ&akid=724%2E21716%2EXy04pQ)

Thank you,
Sarah McBride
